conversations.title: Finding the Platform
conversations.description: Navigate the station to find the correct platform for your train.

messages.text: Buongiorno! Posso aiutarla? Cerca un binario in particolare?
messages.english: Good morning! Can I help you? Are you looking for a specific platform?

choices.text: Sì, grazie. Dove si trova il binario per il treno per Roma?
choices.english: Yes, thanks. Where is the platform for the train to Rome?
choices.feedback: Perfect! Asking for the specific platform for your destination.

choices.text: Il treno per Roma è molto grande e veloce, vero?
choices.english: The train to Rome is very big and fast, right?
choices.feedback: Interesting fact, but it doesn't help you find the platform!

choices.text: Vorrei un caffè e un cornetto al bar della stazione.
choices.english: I would like a coffee and a croissant at the station bar.
choices.feedback: Wrong place! You are at the information desk, not the bar.

messages.text: Certamente. Ha già guardato il tabellone delle partenze?
messages.english: Certainly. Have you already looked at the departures board?

choices.text: Sì, ho guardato. Ma ci sono troppi treni e non capisco.
choices.english: Yes, I looked. But there are too many trains and I don't understand.
choices.feedback: Honest and clear. The assistant will guide you now.

choices.text: Sì, il tabellone è molto alto e luminoso, mi piace.
choices.english: Yes, the board is very high and bright, I like it.
choices.feedback: Too much detail about the board, not enough about your problem.

choices.text: No, non ho fame adesso, preferisco mangiare più tardi.
choices.english: No, I'm not hungry now, I prefer to eat later.
choices.feedback: The host asked about the departures board, not food!

messages.text: Capisco. Il suo treno è l'Intercity 510? Parte dal binario 4.
messages.english: I understand. Is your train the Intercity 510? It departs from platform 4.

choices.text: Binario 4, perfetto. Devo prendere il sottopassaggio?
choices.english: Platform 4, perfect. Do I have to take the underpass?
choices.feedback: Correct! Most platforms are reached via the underpass.

choices.text: Binario 4, bene. Posso comprare un libro qui vicino?
choices.english: Platform 4, good. Can I buy a book nearby?
choices.feedback: Focus on the platform first, shopping comes later!

choices.text: Il numero 4 è il mio numero fortunato, che coincidenza!
choices.english: Number 4 is my lucky number, what a coincidence!
choices.feedback: A nice thought, but ask for directions instead.

messages.text: Esatto. Prenda il sottopassaggio e segua le indicazioni per il binario 4.
messages.english: Exactly. Take the underpass and follow the signs for platform 4.

choices.text: Grazie mille! C'è anche l'ascensore per le valigie?
choices.english: Thank you very much! Is there also an elevator for the suitcases?
choices.feedback: Good question! Elevators are helpful if you have heavy bags.

choices.text: Va bene! Ci sono molte persone nel sottopassaggio?
choices.english: Alright! Are there many people in the underpass?
choices.feedback: The crowd doesn't matter, finding the elevator does.

choices.text: Ottimo! Il sottopassaggio è dipinto di un bel colore?
choices.english: Great! Is the underpass painted a nice color?
choices.feedback: The color of the walls is not important right now!

messages.text: Sì, l'ascensore è proprio accanto alle scale. Ha molte valigie?
messages.english: Yes, the elevator is right next to the stairs. Do you have many suitcases?

choices.text: Sì, ho due valigie grandi e pesanti.
choices.english: Yes, I have two large and heavy suitcases.
choices.feedback: Clear information. The host will help you further.

choices.text: No, ho solo un piccolo zaino con me.
choices.english: No, I only have a small backpack with me.
choices.feedback: If you don't have bags, you don't really need the elevator.

choices.text: Le valigie sono di colore rosso, molto belle.
choices.english: The suitcases are red, very beautiful.
choices.feedback: The color doesn't help with the logistics!

messages.text: Allora l'ascensore è necessario. Il binario 4 è a destra nel corridoio.
messages.english: Then the elevator is necessary. Platform 4 is to the right in the corridor.

choices.text: Grazie, è molto gentile. Il treno è già al binario?
choices.english: Thanks, you're very kind. Is the train already at the platform?
choices.feedback: Good follow-up question to know if you need to hurry.

choices.text: Il corridoio è molto lungo? Sono stanco.
choices.english: Is the corridor very long? I'm tired.
choices.feedback: Focus on finding the train first.

choices.text: A destra? Preferivo andare a sinistra.
choices.english: To the right? I preferred to go to the left.
choices.feedback: Don't argue with directions!

messages.text: No, dovrebbe arrivare tra cinque minuti. Ha tempo.
messages.english: No, it should arrive in five minutes. You have time.

choices.text: Ottimo, ho tutto il tempo. Devo convalidare il biglietto?
choices.english: Great, I have plenty of time. Do I need to validate the ticket?
choices.feedback: Excellent question. Ticket validation is crucial in Italy.

choices.text: Cinque minuti sono troppi, voglio partire ora.
choices.english: Five minutes is too long, I want to leave now.
choices.feedback: Patience is a virtue at the train station.

choices.text: Il tempo vola quando ci si diverte, vero?
choices.english: Time flies when you're having fun, right?
choices.feedback: A bit too philosophical for this situation.

messages.text: Sì, se ha un biglietto cartaceo deve usarle macchinette sul binario.
messages.english: Yes, if you have a paper ticket you must use the machines on the platform.

choices.text: Va bene, lo farò subito. Grazie mille!
choices.english: Alright, I'll do it right away. Thank you very much!
choices.feedback: Good. You are following all necessary steps.

choices.text: Le macchinette sono semplici da usare?
choices.english: Are the machines simple to use?
choices.feedback: They are very simple, just insert the ticket.

choices.text: Non voglio usare la macchinetta, preferisco una persona.
choices.english: I don't want to use the machine, I prefer a person.
choices.feedback: Validation is usually automated.

messages.text: Prego! Ricordi anche di controllare il numero della carrozza.
messages.english: You're welcome! Remember also to check the carriage number.

choices.text: Giusto, il numero della carrozza è importante. Arrivederci!
choices.english: Right, the carriage number is important. Goodbye!
choices.feedback: Polite exit. You are ready to go.

choices.text: La carrozza è come quella di una fiaba?
choices.english: Is the carriage like one from a fairy tale?
choices.feedback: No, it's a modern train car!

choices.text: Non mi piacciono i numeri, sono difficili da ricordare.
choices.english: I don't like numbers, they are hard to remember.
choices.feedback: You need to know your carriage number to find your seat.

messages.text: Arrivederci e buon viaggio per Roma!
messages.english: Goodbye and have a good trip to Rome!

choices.text: Grazie ancora, buona giornata!
choices.english: Thanks again, have a good day!
choices.feedback: Perfect conclusion.

choices.text: Roma è una città con molti monumenti antichi.
choices.english: Rome is a city with many ancient monuments.
choices.feedback: A statement, not a goodbye.

choices.text: Roma è lontana da qui? Grazie.
choices.english: Is Rome far from here? Thanks.
choices.feedback: A bit late for that!

conversations.title: Listening to Announcements
conversations.description: Understand important changes to your train schedule.

messages.text: Attenzione! Il treno regionale per Firenze è in ritardo di dieci minuti.
messages.english: Attention! The regional train to Florence is ten minutes late.

choices.text: Accidenti, dieci minuti di ritardo. Devo aspettare qui?
choices.english: Damn, ten minutes delay. Do I have to wait here?
choices.feedback: Good reaction. Delays are common, and checking where to wait is smart.

choices.text: Dieci minuti sono troppi. Posso andare al cinema ora?
choices.english: Ten minutes are too many. Can I go to the cinema now?
choices.feedback: Ten minutes isn't enough for a movie! Stay at the platform.

choices.text: Firenze è una città bellissima, voglio vedere i musei.
choices.english: Florence is a beautiful city, I want to see the museums.
choices.feedback: True, but focus on the delay first!

messages.text: Sì, il treno arriverà a breve. Attenzione: c'è un cambio di binario.
messages.english: Yes, the train will arrive shortly. Attention: there is a platform change.

choices.text: Un cambio di binario? Qual è il nuovo binario per favore?
choices.english: A platform change? Which is the new platform please?
choices.feedback: Critical information! You need to know where the train is going now.

choices.text: Un cambio di treno? Devo comprare un altro biglietto?
choices.english: A train change? Do I have to buy another ticket?
choices.feedback: Listen carefully: it's a platform change, not a train change.

choices.text: Il binario è un posto molto lungo e stretto, vero?
choices.english: The platform is a very long and narrow place, right?
choices.feedback: Not the time for definitions!

messages.text: Il treno partirà dal binario 6 invece del binario 4. Si scusi per il disagio.
messages.english: The train will depart from platform 6 instead of platform 4. Sorry for the inconvenience.

choices.text: Va bene, vado subito al binario 6. È lontano da qui?
choices.english: Alright, I'm going to platform 6 right away. Is it far from here?
choices.feedback: Moving quickly to the new platform is the right move.

choices.text: Il binario 6 è lontano? Ho molte valigie pesanti.
choices.english: Is platform 6 far? I have many heavy suitcases.
choices.feedback: Just go! The train is arriving soon.

choices.text: Non mi piace il numero 6, preferivo il numero 4.
choices.english: I don't like the number 6, I preferred the number 4.
choices.feedback: Personal preferences don't change the train schedule!

messages.text: No, è proprio il binario accanto. Attenzione, allontanarsi dalla linea gialla.
messages.english: No, it's right at the next platform. Attention, stand back from the yellow line.

choices.text: Sì, mi allontano subito. Il treno sta arrivando ora?
choices.english: Yes, I'm moving away immediately. Is the train arriving now?
choices.feedback: Safety first! And good awareness of the train's arrival.

choices.text: La linea gialla è molto luminosa, è di un bel colore.
choices.english: The yellow line is very bright, it's a nice color.
choices.feedback: Don't admire the line, step back from it!

choices.text: Il treno è blu e grigio? Mi sembra molto moderno.
choices.english: Is the train blue and grey? It seems very modern to me.
choices.feedback: Watch out for the arriving train instead of its color.

messages.text: Sì, il treno regionale sta entrando in stazione. Faccia attenzione.
messages.english: Yes, the regional train is entering the station. Be careful.

choices.text: Vedo il treno! Devo salire subito quando si ferma?
choices.english: I see the train! Should I board immediately when it stops?
choices.feedback: Good question about boarding etiquette.

choices.text: Il treno fa molto rumore, mi dà fastidio alle orecchie.
choices.english: The train makes a lot of noise, it bothers my ears.
choices.feedback: Trains are noisy, that's normal.

choices.text: Voglio correre verso il treno mentre si muove.
choices.english: I want to run towards the train while it's moving.
choices.feedback: Very dangerous! Never do that.

messages.text: No, aspetti che i passeggeri scendano prima di salire.
messages.english: No, wait for the passengers to get off before boarding.

choices.text: Giusto, è più educato. Grazie per l'avviso.
choices.english: Right, it's more polite. Thanks for the warning.
choices.feedback: Correct. Letting people off first is the rule.

choices.text: Perché? Io ho fretta e voglio sedermi subito.
choices.english: Why? I'm in a hurry and I want to sit down immediately.
choices.feedback: It's better to wait to avoid a collision in the doorway.

choices.text: Le persone che scendono sono tante o poche?
choices.english: Are there many or few people getting off?
choices.feedback: It doesn't matter, you still have to wait.

messages.text: Prego. Il treno è fermo al binario 6. Salire a bordo.
messages.english: You're welcome. The train is stopped at platform 6. Please board.

choices.text: Perfetto, vado. Dove posso mettere la mia valigia?
choices.english: Perfect, I'm going. Where can I put my suitcase?
choices.feedback: Good practical question for boarding.

choices.text: Il treno è fermo? Forse è rotto e non parte più.
choices.english: Is the train stopped? Maybe it's broken and won't leave anymore.
choices.feedback: It's stopped for passengers to board, not because it's broken!

choices.text: A bordo c'è un ristorante? Ho molta fame adesso.
choices.english: Is there a restaurant on board? I'm very hungry now.
choices.feedback: Regional trains usually don't have restaurants!

messages.text: Ci sono gli spazi sopra i sedili o all'inizio della carrozza.
messages.english: There are spaces above the seats or at the beginning of the carriage.

choices.text: Bene, cercherò un posto libero vicino al bagaglio.
choices.english: Good, I'll look for a free seat near the luggage.
choices.feedback: Keeping an eye on your luggage is always a good idea.

choices.text: Voglio mettere la valigia sul sedile accanto a me.
choices.english: I want to put the suitcase on the seat next to me.
choices.feedback: Seats are for passengers, not luggage!

choices.text: Il bagaglio è troppo grande, forse non ci sta.
choices.english: The luggage is too big, maybe it won't fit.
choices.feedback: Try the racks at the end of the car then.

messages.text: Ottima idea. Il treno partirà tra due minuti.
messages.english: Great idea. The train will depart in two minutes.

choices.text: Perfetto, entro subito. Grazie ancora e buona giornata!
choices.english: Perfect, I'm going in right away. Thanks again and have a good day!
choices.feedback: Success! You caught the train despite the changes.

choices.text: Due minuti sono pochissimi, non ce la farò mai!
choices.english: Two minutes are very few, I'll never make it!
choices.feedback: You are already there, just step inside!

choices.text: Il treno è veloce come un razzo spaziale?
choices.english: Is the train as fast as a space rocket?
choices.feedback: Not quite, but it's fast enough.

messages.text: Buon viaggio e buona permanenza a Firenze!
messages.english: Have a good trip and a nice stay in Florence!

choices.text: Grazie, arrivederci!
choices.english: Thanks, goodbye!
choices.feedback: Polite conclusion.

choices.text: Firenze è bella? Ciao!
choices.english: Is Florence beautiful? Bye!
choices.feedback: A fact, but not a goodbye.

choices.text: Arrivederci, a presto!
choices.english: Goodbye, see you soon!
choices.feedback: That's not possible!

conversations.title: Validating the Ticket
conversations.description: Ensure your ticket is validated before boarding to avoid a fine.

messages.text: Scusi, ha già convalidato il suo biglietto cartaceo?
messages.english: Excuse me, have you already validated your paper ticket?

choices.text: Oh, no! Ho dimenticato. Dove posso obliterare il biglietto?
choices.english: Oh, no! I forgot. Where can I validate the ticket?
choices.feedback: Good catch! Validating is essential for paper tickets.

choices.text: Sì, il biglietto è nel mio portafoglio con i soldi.
choices.english: Yes, the ticket is in my wallet with the money.
choices.feedback: Having it isn't enough; you must validate it!

choices.text: Il biglietto è di carta? Mi piace molto la carta.
choices.english: The ticket is paper? I like paper very much.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant! You need to stamp it.

messages.text: Vede quella macchinetta verde e grigia sul binario? Deve usarla.
messages.english: Do you see that green and grey machine on the platform? You must use it.

choices.text: Ah, quella macchinetta? Va bene, vado subito. Come funziona?
choices.english: Ah, that machine? Alright, I'll go right away. How does it work?
choices.feedback: Moving to the validation machine and asking for instructions.

choices.text: La macchinetta è rotta? Sembra molto vecchia.
choices.english: Is the machine broken? It looks very old.
choices.feedback: Don't assume it's broken, try it first!

choices.text: Preferisco le macchinette rosse, sono più belle.
choices.english: I prefer red machines, they are more beautiful.
choices.feedback: Colors don't matter, finding the machine does!

messages.text: Inserisca il biglietto nella fessura finché non sente un rumore.
messages.english: Insert the ticket into the slot until you hear a noise.

choices.text: Ecco, fatto. Ho sentito il rumore. Ora il biglietto è valido?
choices.english: Here, done. I heard the noise. Is the ticket valid now?
choices.feedback: Perfect. You followed the mechanical instructions.

choices.text: Il rumore è molto forte? Ho paura dei rumori.
choices.english: Is the noise very loud? I'm afraid of noises.
choices.feedback: It's just a small stamp sound, nothing to fear!

choices.text: Il biglietto è ancora intero? Non volevo romperlo.
choices.english: Is the ticket still whole? I didn't want to break it.
choices.feedback: The machine stamps a date, it doesn't destroy it.

messages.text: Sì, ora c'è la data e l'ora sopra. Può salire senza problemi.
messages.english: Yes, now there is the date and time on it. You can board without problems.

choices.text: Meno male! Non volevo prendere una multa dal controllore.
choices.english: Thank goodness! I didn't want to get a fine from the controller.
choices.feedback: Exactly. Fines for unvalidated tickets are expensive.

choices.text: Il controllore è una persona simpatica e gentile?
choices.english: Is the controller a nice and kind person?
choices.feedback: Maybe, but he will still fine you if you don't validate!

choices.text: La data di oggi è importante per me, è il mio compleanno.
choices.english: Today's date is important to me, it's my birthday.
choices.feedback: Happy birthday, but stay focused on the ticket!

messages.text: Esatto, i controllori sono severi. Ha anche un biglietto elettronico?
messages.english: Exactly, controllers are strict. Do you also have an electronic ticket?

choices.text: No, ho solo questo cartaceo per oggi.
choices.english: No, I only have this paper one for today.
choices.feedback: Clear answer. Many people use apps now, but paper is still valid if stamped.

choices.text: Sì, ho dieci biglietti elettronici sul mio telefono.
choices.english: Yes, I have ten electronic tickets on my phone.
choices.feedback: Why so many? Just one is enough.

choices.text: Sì, ho il biglietto sullo smartphone.
choices.english: Yes, I have the ticket on my smartphone.
choices.feedback: Not very practical for train travel!

messages.text: Va bene. Ricordi di tenerlo a portata di mano per il controllo.
messages.english: Fine. Remember to keep it at hand for the check.

choices.text: Lo terrò in tasca così è facile da trovare.
choices.english: I'll keep it in my pocket so it's easy to find.
choices.feedback: Good planning.

choices.text: Voglio nasconderlo bene nella mia valigia grande.
choices.english: I want to hide it well in my large suitcase.
choices.feedback: That will be hard to find when the controller comes!

choices.text: Il controllore ha una divisa blu e un cappello?
choices.english: Does the controller have a blue uniform and a hat?
choices.feedback: Usually yes, but focus on your ticket.

messages.text: Sì, è meglio. Il treno per la sua destinazione parte tra poco.
messages.english: Yes, it's better. The train to your destination leaves shortly.

choices.text: Quanto tempo manca alla partenza?
choices.english: How much time is left until departure?
choices.feedback: Important question to manage your time.

choices.text: Il tempo è relativo, diceva Einstein.
choices.english: Time is relative, Einstein used to say.
choices.feedback: Not at the train station, it's very absolute!

choices.text: Voglio restare qui a guardare la macchinetta.
choices.english: I want to stay here and watch the machine.
choices.feedback: You'll miss your train!

messages.text: Mancano solo due minuti. Si affretti verso il binario!
messages.english: Only two minutes left. Hurry to the platform!

choices.text: Due minuti? Allora corro subito! Grazie ancora.
choices.english: Two minutes? Then I'll run right away! Thanks again.
choices.feedback: Correct action. Time to move.

choices.text: Due minuti sono sufficienti per fare una corsa lenta.
choices.english: Two minutes are enough for a slow run.
choices.feedback: With luggage, you should probably move faster.

choices.text: Non mi piace correre, preferisco perdere il treno.
choices.english: I don't like running, I prefer to miss the train.
choices.feedback: That defeats the purpose of your trip!

messages.text: Prego! Non dimentichi nulla sulla panchina.
messages.english: You're welcome! Don't forget anything on the bench.

choices.text: Ho preso tutto, borsa e biglietto. Buona giornata!
choices.english: I've taken everything, bag and ticket. Have a good day!
choices.feedback: Ready to go.

choices.text: La panchina è comoda, forse resto qui.
choices.english: The bench is comfortable, maybe I'll stay here.
choices.feedback: You need to get on the train!

choices.text: Ho dimenticato il mio gatto immaginario!
choices.english: I forgot my imaginary cat!
choices.feedback: Let's focus on real items.

messages.text: Buon viaggio! Si ricordi di scendere alla fermata giusta.
messages.english: Have a good trip! Remember to get off at the right stop.

choices.text: Sì, starò attento. Arrivederci!
choices.english: Yes, I'll be careful. Goodbye!
choices.feedback: Final polite goodbye.

choices.text: La fermata è vicina? Arrivederci!
choices.english: Is the stop nearby? Goodbye!
choices.feedback: Check the station name, not the flowers!

choices.text: Scenderò quando il treno smette di muoversi.
choices.english: I'll get off when the train stops moving.
choices.feedback: That's generally how it works, but at the right station!

conversations.title: Boarding the Carriage
conversations.description: Find your carriage and your reserved seat on the train.

messages.text: Prego, salga pure. Ha una prenotazione per un posto a sedere?
messages.english: Please, come on board. Do you have a reservation for a seat?

choices.text: Sì, ho il posto 14A nella carrozza 5. Dove si trova?
choices.english: Yes, I have seat 14A in carriage 5. Where is it?
choices.feedback: Good. Providing specific seat and carriage numbers.

choices.text: No, preferisco stare in piedi tutto il tempo.
choices.english: No, I prefer to stand all the time.
choices.feedback: On a long trip, you will definitely want a seat!

choices.text: Il treno ha molte ruote? Mi sembrano tante.
choices.english: Does the train have many wheels? They seem like a lot to me.
choices.feedback: The number of wheels is irrelevant to your seat!

messages.text: Questa è la carrozza 3. Deve camminare avanti verso la testa del treno.
messages.english: This is carriage 3. You must walk forward towards the head of the train.

choices.text: Ho capito, devo andare avanti per trovare la carrozza 5.
choices.english: Understood, I have to go forward to find carriage 5.
choices.feedback: Correct. Navigating the train cars.

choices.text: La testa del treno è molto grande e nera?
choices.english: Is the head of the train very big and black?
choices.feedback: It's just a direction, don't worry about the engine's look.

choices.text: Preferisco andare indietro, la coda è più tranquilla.
choices.english: I prefer to go backwards, the tail is quieter.
choices.feedback: Your carriage is in the other direction!

messages.text: Esatto. Tenga la destra nel corridoio per lasciar passare gli altri.
messages.english: Exactly. Keep to the right in the corridor to let others pass.

choices.text: Va bene. Le carrozze sono numerate chiaramente?
choices.english: Alright. Are the carriages numbered clearly?
choices.feedback: Good question for a traveler.

choices.text: Il corridoio è stretto come un tubo?
choices.english: Is the corridor narrow like a tube?
choices.feedback: It's a standard train corridor.

choices.text: Voglio correre nel corridoio e saltare.
choices.english: I want to run in the corridor and jump.
choices.feedback: Please don't, it's dangerous and annoying for others.

messages.text: Sì, vede il numero sul display vicino alla porta?
messages.english: Yes, do you see the number on the display near the door?

choices.text: Ah sì, ora vedo. Questa è la carrozza 4, quindi la prossima è la 5.
choices.english: Ah yes, now I see. This is carriage 4, so the next one is 5.
choices.feedback: Good observation. You are almost there.

choices.text: Il display è troppo luminoso, mi fa male agli occhi.
choices.english: The display is too bright, it hurts my eyes.
choices.feedback: It's just for information, try not to stare at it.

choices.text: Il numero 4 è un numero pari, mi piace.
choices.english: The number 4 is an even number, I like it.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant to your travel.

messages.text: Perfetto. Ecco la carrozza 5. Cerchi il posto 14A, è vicino al finestrino.
messages.english: Perfect. Here is carriage 5. Look for seat 14A, it's near the window.

choices.text: Ottimo, adoro guardare fuori dal finestrino durante il viaggio.
choices.english: Great, I love looking out the window during the trip.
choices.feedback: Nice. Window seats are great for sightseeing.

choices.text: Il finestrino è pulito? Spero di vedere bene.
choices.english: Is the window clean? I hope to see well.
choices.feedback: Don't worry about that now, just find the seat.

choices.text: Il posto 14A è di velluto rosso o di pelle blu?
choices.english: Is seat 14A red velvet or blue leather?
choices.feedback: The material doesn't matter, just the number!

messages.text: Sistemiamo le valigie sopra il sedile, nello spazio apposito.
messages.english: Let's put the suitcases above the seat, in the designated space.

choices.text: Grazie, le mie valigie sono pesanti. Mi aiuta per favore?
choices.english: Thanks, my suitcases are heavy. Can you help me please?
choices.feedback: Good request for help with heavy luggage.

choices.text: Sopra il sedile? Ho paura che cadano sulla testa.
choices.english: Above the seat? I'm afraid they'll fall on my head.
choices.feedback: They are secure in the luggage racks, don't worry.

choices.text: Le valigie sono piene di vestiti e scarpe nuove.
choices.english: The suitcases are full of new clothes and shoes.
choices.feedback: The contents of your bags don't matter right now.

messages.text: Certamente. Ecco fatto. C'è spazio per tutto.
messages.english: Certainly. There we go. There's space for everything.

choices.text: Grazie mille, è stato molto gentile ad aiutarmi.
choices.english: Thank you very much, you were very kind to help me.
choices.feedback: Polite appreciation.

choices.text: Lo spazio è infinito come l'universo?
choices.english: Is space infinite like the universe?
choices.feedback: No, it's just a luggage rack.

choices.text: Voglio mettere anche le mie scarpe lassù.
choices.english: I want to put my shoes up there too.
choices.feedback: Keep your shoes on your feet or in your bag!

messages.text: Prego. Ora si sieda e si rilassi. Il viaggio dura due ore.
messages.english: You're welcome. Now sit down and relax. The trip lasts two hours.

choices.text: Due ore sono perfette per leggere un libro.
choices.english: Two hours are perfect for reading a book.
choices.feedback: Good way to spend the time.

choices.text: Due ore? È un tempo lunghissimo, mi annoierò.
choices.english: Two hours? It's a very long time, I'll get bored.
choices.feedback: It's quite fast for a train trip!

choices.text: Voglio dormire per due ore e sognare.
choices.english: I want to sleep for two hours and dream.
choices.feedback: Fine, but maybe say something more conversational.

messages.text: Ottima idea. Se ha sete, c'è il carrello bar tra poco.
messages.english: Great idea. If you are thirsty, there's the bar trolley shortly.

choices.text: Grazie per l'informazione. Magari prenderò un'acqua.
choices.english: Thanks for the information. Maybe I'll have a water.
choices.feedback: Useful to know about on-board services.

choices.text: Il carrello bar vende anche automobili?
choices.english: Does the bar trolley also sell cars?
choices.feedback: No, just drinks and snacks!

choices.text: Ho molta sete, voglio bere un litro di succo d'arancia.
choices.english: I'm very thirsty, I want to drink a liter of orange juice.
choices.feedback: They might have small bottles, not liters!

messages.text: Perfetto. Ora la lascio riposare. Buon viaggio!
messages.english: Perfect. Now I'll let you rest. Have a good trip!

choices.text: Grazie mille per tutto. Finalmente posso riposare.
choices.english: Thank you very much for everything. Finally I can rest.
choices.feedback: Perfect finish. You are settled and ready for your journey.

choices.text: Mi rilasso molto, forse dormo per tre ore.
choices.english: I relax a lot, maybe I'll sleep for three hours.
choices.feedback: The host said the trip is only two hours!

choices.text: Il sedile è comodo? Spero che sia morbidissimo.
choices.english: Is the seat comfortable? I hope it's very soft.
choices.feedback: You are already sitting down, you can feel it!
